record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.75 to 0.775. The observed regressions at 0.70 and 0.80 motivate testing a smaller step near the incumbent, without assuming a monotonic response. Retain width 64, input/output tying, frequency modulation, topology, history, scoring, loss and optimizer. Use identical effective embedding weights during training and prediction.
